header: Operator details as label and value pairs
text: Two to twelve pairs in a real description list, in two to four columns. The value holds a short number or ID; the text holds the sentence that explains it.
note: This is a summary, not a replacement for the imprint. The required details depend on the operator, so the link leads to the full imprint.

rows.title: The title is the term
rows.text: and the text is the sentence under it

rows.title: A pair may have only a value
or only a text
rows.text: Long text wraps inside its column

rows.title: Identifiers break anywhere
rows.text: A VAT ID has no natural break point
